app.name: AniPub
app.one_liner: A modern, ad-free, privacy-first anime streaming platform with AI assistance and community features.

screens.name: Anime Details
screens.purpose: Show comprehensive information about a specific anime including plot, ratings, streaming links, and community comments.

screens.name: Home
screens.purpose: Display featured, trending, and categorized anime with responsive layout and genre shortcuts.

screens.name: Login / Registration
screens.purpose: Authenticate users with email/password and planned GitHub OAuth.

rust_commands.name: fetch_ai_response
rust_commands.purpose: Query AniPub AI 'Zero Two' for recommendations, trivia, or summaries.

rust_commands.name: rate_anime
rust_commands.purpose: Submit a user rating for an anime title.

rust_commands.name: save_item
rust_commands.purpose: Save an anime or episode to the user's watchlist or playlist.

mvp_plan: week 1: Implement core routing for home, details, and login screens
week 1: Integrate basic watchlist saving functionality
week 1: Set up user rating submission and display
acceptance_tests: Community comments appear in threaded view on anime details page.
Streaming links on details page load functional video sources.
User can log in using /login route and access personalized features.
User can navigate from home screen to anime details page via click.
